conventions.furniture: furn_<room>_<item>_<R|L>.png; R = facing the right-hand wall, L = facing the left-hand wall. pos_in_ref/size_in_ref = where the item sat in the 2:1 isometric reference room (grey or cream) it was painted in, in that image's pixels; use it to derive the floor anchor.
conventions.rooms/walls, rooms/floors: 2048 px seamless tiles (flat, unprojected); project onto the 10x10 corner room in code, then multiply by the light map.
conventions.rooms/lightmaps: lm_<time>_<left|right|floor>.npy = float32 512x512 multiplier (1.0 = neutral); .png is a preview. Times: morning, midday, evening, overcast, night.
conventions.rooms/windows, rooms/doors: <kind>_<id>.png = frame with transparent opening; <kind>_<id>_opening.png = mask of the opening (white) for the view behind. door_iso_<id>.png = a door painted in 3D at the left wall's 2:1 angle (frame, wall depth, door), no mask: bottom-left = the frame's front foot, right edge = its back foot (tools/asset-pipeline/isodoors.py).
conventions.world/houses: ext_<id>.png façade; ext_<id>_glass.png = window glass mask; _dooropen and _snow are repainted variants (not pixel-aligned: cross-fade).
conventions.world/terrain: terr_<biome>_<season>.png, transparent sky; draw the sky in code behind it.
conventions.world/map: Equirectangular 4096x2048: x = (lon+180)/360*W, y = (90-lat)/180*H. map_biome.png is an index image, legend in map_biome_legend.json.
conventions.cat/base: cat_<set>_<view>_<part>.png; views side|tqfront|front|tqback; parts head, ear_far, ear_near, torso, leg_front_near, leg_front_far, leg_back_near, leg_back_far, tail_up, tail_curl, tail_low; _whole = the standing reference for assembling the puppet.
conventions.cat/expressions: head_<view>_<expression>.png: whole replacement heads (with ears) for calm, slowblink, content, surprised, sleepy, squint; views tqfront|front|side.
conventions.cat/marked: Same part names as cat/base, repainted with the marking; swap the whole part set for a marked cat.
conventions.outfits: outfit_<id>_<view>.png; anchor head items between the ears, neck items at the neck, body items over the torso.
conventions.widget: widget_<id>[_wide].png frame with transparent glass + _glass.png mask; draw sky/weather behind, the cat on the sill.
conventions.audio: 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV. Cat voices and the purr are real recordings (public domain / CC0, from Wikimedia Commons, credited in audio/CREDITS_cat_sounds.json and each manifest entry); UI, ambience, sleep breathing and zoomies are synthesised in code (synth.py). Loops are seamless.
conventions.brand/icon: AppIcon_1024.png is the flattened icon. For the iOS 26 layered icon (Icon Composer) use AppIcon_layer1_background.png behind AppIcon_layer2_cat.png; the system makes the dark, tinted and clear looks from the layers. alt_AppIcon_* are the other three concepts.
conventions.brand/logo: logo_sleeping_on_<light|dark>.png is the secondary logo (Josh, 19 Oct 2026: it replaces the stacked logo with the cat in the house): the wordmark with Midnight curled up asleep on the letters, where the animated logo ends, 1647 x 540, built by tools/asset-pipeline/logo/sleeping_logo.py from the wordmark and the curl painting. wordmark_on_<light|dark>.png: the letters alone, cut from the horizontal logos by tools/asset-pipeline/wordmark.py, along the bottom of a 1647 x 480 box with clear room above them for the cat (the launch-screen mark and the animated logo, HouseCatGame LogoScene; Tuning.Logo measures the letters in the box's pixels). logo_<horizontal|stacked>_on_light.png (dark ink) and _on_dark.png (cream ink) are the original logos with the cat in the house, kept as they were. All transparent. logo_curl_film.mp4: the animated logo's landing and curling up (Higgsfield, Kling 3.0 Omni with first and last frames, 8 s, 1920 x 1080 at 24 fps): Midnight on chroma green on a dark ledge for the letter tops, from frames of the game's own paintings (the test renderTheCurlKeyframes), keyed by tools/asset-pipeline/logo/curlkey.py into the logo's films (tools/app-assets/build_logo_film.sh).
conventions.cat/poses: cat_<set>_<pose>.png per coat (plain, tuxedo, locket, socks): whole-cat paintings for the resting poses the puppet cannot make well: sit (side, tqfront, front, back), loaf (side, tqfront), sleep_curl, stretch_side. sit_back is the widget pose (the cat looking out of the window). Use the puppet for moving, these for resting; cross-fade between them.
conventions.cat/custom/base: The cat builder art, painted WHITE: parts/cat_<body>_<view>_<part>.png (8 bodies: short_slim, short_chunky, long_slim, long_chunky, persian, siamese, mainecoon, sphynx; parts as cat/base), poses/cat_<body>_<pose>[__<ears>|__bobtail|__<ears>_bobtail].png, expr/head_<stdnoear|persian|siamese|mainecoon|sphynx|std>_<view>_<expression>.png (stdnoear = the standard bodies, ears come from the parts), ears/ear_<rounded|folded|tufted|oriental>_<view>_<far|near>.png, tails/bobtail_<view>_<up|curl|low>.png, whole/cat_<breed>_<view>_whole.png (assembly reference for the breeds). Tint in code with the coat recipe; catbuilder.json has the data and presets.
conventions.cat/custom/mask: masks/<mask>/<same path as the base sprite>: 8-bit greyscale, same size as the sprite. tabby_mackerel, tabby_classic, spotted, tortie, colourpoint: 255 = pattern colour. white_mitts, white_tuxedo, white_bicolour, white_van: 255 = the fur stays white. features (RGB): R = iris of the eye on the image left (the only eye in a side view), G = the other iris, B = nose leather. A missing mask = 0 everywhere.
conventions.fx: Animated effects. Loops: fire, candle, steam, smoke, water_trickle, water_ripple, butterfly (fx_<name>_NN.png frames in one cell size + a _strip.png). Sprites: robin poses, reaction icons. fx/fx.json has frame counts, cell sizes and anchors; fx/anchors.json (also copied into each furniture entry as motion_fx) says where flames and steam attach on the moving furniture.
conventions.fixture: Parts of the house drawn by the house view, not catalogue items (the staircase); placed by assets/rooms/houses.json.
conventions.world/scenes: <house>_<biome>_<season>[_dooropen].jpg = the home painted into its place (16:9, noon); _land.png = 1 painting / 0 sky (the sky is drawn in code); _glass.png = window glass, lit in code; scenes.json = door points. Made by tools/asset-pipeline/scenes.py.
conventions.world/intro: Exteriors painted for the intro's tour alone (Josh, 20 Oct): the London terrace fully decorated, a beach house in Bali; files as world/scenes, door points and house boxes in world/scenes/scenes.json. Kept out of world/scenes so no home's own set picks them up.
conventions.world/ground: 2048 px seamless tiles seen from above: the ground around the house in the house view, one per biome plus ground_autumn (a leafy lawn). Same model and brushwork reference as the floors (tools/asset-pipeline/surfaces.py FLOOR_T, gpt_image_2_5, 18 Oct).
conventions.ui/shop: The shop offer illustrations (Cat Club, Starter Pack, Housewarming, Forever Home, Adopt a Cat, Gifts), painted on magenta and keyed, transparent background (gpt_image_2_5, the mascot master plate as reference for the cat, 18 Oct).
